name: AIFU Inc.
summary: AIFU Inc., through its subsidiary, distributes insurance products in China. The company provides life and health insurance products, such as individual whole life, individual health, individual annuity, individual term life, individual endowment life, and participating insurance products; and non-life insurance products primarily includes individual accident, travel, homeowner, indemnity medical, commercial property, cargo, hull, liability, construction and erection, and extended warranty insurance products.
